Synopsis:
After giving Astarion the Tome of Thayan Necromancy, he begins to study it at camp to learn its secrets. He's frustrated by the voices of the spirits contained within the book, which are stopping him from accessing the secrets he's sure it contains. If he pushes the spirits too far, they'll respond with force - tearing at him with spectral hands. As you discuss the book with Astarion, his tone is on edge - nearly obsessive about discovering what's in the book. He won't part with it, even if he can't read it right now.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_DangerousBook_IVB_CFM_Astarion.json: Off-screen, the player handed Astarion the Tome of Thayan Necromancy and he took it back to camp to pry its secrets loose. Astarion is a tadpoled survivor and vampire spawn already struggling with loss of control and identity, so he’s driven and nearly obsessive about anything that might restore power or knowledge. The book is inhabited by whispering spirits that tempt him with necromantic promises and will lash out — manifesting invisible, grasping hands — if he pushes them too far. Though he can’t fully read it yet and is clearly unsettled, he refuses to part with the tome and masks his fear with sharpness and bravado toward the player.
- FOR_DangerousBook_Tome.json: The player finds a book on necromancy - from one of the Red Wizards of Thay. Once read, the book will be bound to whoever tried to read it. Some origins will demand you let them read it, while others will want the book burned. If you read the book, you'll hear strange, distant whispers. The more you read, the stronger the voices will become, and the greater the chance that you'll be driven mad.
- FOR_DangerousBook_PAD_FindBook.json: PAD when you pick up 'The Necromancy of Thay' (DangerousBook_Tome.lsj). Character might have a sense that the book is evil or just be curious about what it might contain.
- LOW_CazadorsPalace_Crypt_PAD_ScrollOfNames.json: Player reads "Scroll of Names" - scroll with names of all the victims that Cazador was/is planning to sacrifice.Astarion makes a comment about it.Different comment depending on Astarion's state a) Astarion is a Vampire Lord b) Astarion is Vampire Spawn c) Astarion knows about the ritual d) none of the above
- LOW_PhilgravesMansion_FatherCarrion.json: Dialog with Mystic Carrion, a mummy lord hiding in the Lower City. Players who carry the Necromancy of Thay (unread) have the chance to take part in a seance where they can learn how the book can be opened. Players can also take on a quest from Carrion, to bring back his runaway zombie beggar Thrumbo (potentially in exchange for the torch of revocation, intended to help Oskar).Various conclusions are available for the quest to help Mystic Carrion - if the player succeeds in bringing himThrumbo's torso, he will reward them with a Torch of revocation which can be used to cure Oskar's possession (Oskar's Beloved). If you refuse him, he will attack you, and keep returnign from the dead until you destroy his canopic jar (hidden inside Thrumbo)

context: Off-screen, the player handed Astarion the Tome of Thayan Necromancy and he took it back to camp to pry its secrets loose. Astarion — a vampire spawn already struggling with loss of control and identity — is driven and nearly obsessive about anything that might restore power or knowledge, so he refuses to part with the book even though he can’t fully read it yet. The tome is inhabited by whispering spirits that tempt him with necromantic promises and, if provoked, lash out as invisible, grasping spectral hands that physically attack him and force him to shut the book. The voices grow stronger the more the book is read and the book is dangerous enough that it can bind to the reader, so Astarion masks his fear with sharpness and bravado while insisting on continuing his study.
